questions.question:
**Examine the four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. Wasserkopf returns to his school and asks for a refund of his tuition fee.

B. ‘Refund’ by Karinthy is a hilarious play about a student named Wasserkopf.

C. However, the situation changes when the Mathematics teacher asks him to calculate the total amount.

D. He further declares that he had learnt nothing at school in all the years.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**BADC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• **Sentence B **will be the starting line because it contains the main idea of the para jumble i.e. Refund(a play).
 
• **Sentence A** states that Wasserkopf returned to his school and asked for a refund of his tuition fee. So, **A** will follow **B**.
 
• Further,** Sentence D** states that he further declared that he was asking for a refund because he had learned nothing at school & **Sentence C **states that the situation changed when the Mathematics teacher asked him to calculate the total amount of his refund. So, **C** will follow **D**.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: ‘Refund’ by Karinthy is a hilarious play about a student named Wasserkopf.
 
• **A**: Wasserkopf returns to his school and asks for a refund of his tuition fee.
 
• **D**: He further declares that he had learnt nothing at school in all the years.
 
• **C**: However, the situation changes when the Mathematics teacher asks him to calculate the total amount.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *‘Refund’ by Karinthy is a hilarious play about a student named Wasserkopf. Wasserkopf returns to his school and asks for a refund of his tuition fee. He further declares that he had learnt nothing at school in all the years. However, the situation changes when the Mathematics teacher asks him to calculate the total amount.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

How many languages do you learn at school?

options.text: How many languages will you learn at school?
Languages are learnt by how many at school?
How many languages are learnt by you at school?
How many languages have you being learnt by you learning at school?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'How many languages are learnt by you at school?'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• In 'active-passive' transformation except for (who and whom) rest of the Wh-family Pronouns will remain unchanged. 
 
• Here in the given question 'How many languages' will remain unchanged.
 
• 'do learn' will be changed into 'are learnt'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added. **
 
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ *How many languages are learnt by you at school?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice का उदाहरण है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• 'Active-Passive' परिवर्तन में **(who और whom)** को छोड़कर शेष Wh- परिवार pronouns अपरिवर्तित रहेंगे।
 
• यहां, दिए गए प्रश्न में 'How many languages' अपरिवर्तित रहेंगी।
 
• 'do learnt**' को 'are learnt' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• अंत में, preposition 'by' जोड़ा जाएगा।

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. One day the tailor and his wife discovered that their son was not in the house.

B. The father went to the roadside and shouted, “John!”

C. No one answered.

D. They looked in the garden, and did not find him there.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**ADBC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting off a story, starting of an incident or an event, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• **Sentence A** will be the starting line because it contains the main idea of the **para jumble i.e. the tailor and his wife discovering that their son was not in the house.**
 
• However, **Sentence D** states that they looked in the garden, and did not find him there. So, **D** will follow **A**.
 
• Further,** Sentence B **states that the father after looking in the garden went to the roadside and shouted, “John!” &** Sentence C** states that no one answered. So, **C** will follow **B**.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **A**: One day the tailor and his wife discovered that their son was not in the house.
 
• **D**: They looked in the garden, and did not find him there.
 
• **B**: The father went to the roadside and shouted, “John!”
 
• **C**: No one answered.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *One day the tailor and his wife discovered that their son was not in the house. They looked in the garden, and did not find him there. The father went to the roadside and shouted, “John!” No one answered.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• Here, in the given question 'said to' will be changed into 'told' because the reporting speech has an object. 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The pronoun 'I' will be changed into 'he'. 
 
• 'cannot take' will be changed into 'could not take'. 
 
• '**These**' will be changed into '**those**'.
 
• '**are**' will be changed into '**were**'.

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The chemist told me that he could not take those medicines back as they were special medicines.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Direct Speech** में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **Indirect Speech** में बदलना है।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• यहां, दिए गए प्रश्न में 'said to' को 'told' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि reporting speech में एक object है।
 
• संयोजन 'that' जोड़ा जाएगा और अल्पविराम और उल्टे अल्पविराम हटा दिए जाएंगे।
 
• सर्वनाम 'I' को '**he**' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• 'cannot take' को 'could not take' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• '**are**' को '**were**' में बदल दिया जाएगा।

It has been announced that after a gap of almost two months, domestic flight services will ______ from next week.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**resume**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**resume**'.
 
• It means **'to begin again or continue after a pause or interruption'**. [पुनः आरंभ होना या करना, जारी रहना या रखना (विराम या बाधा के बाद)]
 
 
• *Example: Normal service will **resume** as soon as possible.*
 
 
 
• If we resume activity or if it resumes, it begins again.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *It has been announced that after a gap of almost two months, domestic flight services will **resume** from next week.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• **Proceed**: to continue doing something; to continue being done. (कुछ करना जारी रखना; कोई बात होते रहना)
